recentItems.title: Company of Heroes 3 - Official Operation Torch Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the launch trailer for the new single player DLC Operation Torch for the WW2 strategy game Company of Heroes 3! Manage the battlefield in this single-player campaign across 15 unique missions in North Africa, 1942. Take part in the iconic battles like Hill 609, and Kasserine Pass as you master the battlefield with new vehicles, weaponry and upgrades. 

Company of Heroes 3 Operation Torch is out now for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: NBA 2K27 x GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Season 3 Trailer
recentItems.description: Take a look at the GTA 6-inspired Season 3 Trailer for NBA 2K27, the hit basketball simulation game developed by Visual Concepts. Players can keep the Vice City vibes going with the extended Season 3, packed with Vice City-inspired content and rewards, a brand-new Vice City-inspired Park, Vice City and Los Santos jerseys, and so much more. Celebrate the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 with Season 3 of NBA 2K27, running from November 27 through January 15, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: The Division 2 - Official Spearfall Launch Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at the Spearfall Launch Trailer for The Division 2, the hit third-person action RPG shooter developed by Ubisoft. Players can take on the fierce White Tusk that has infiltrated the open world for the first time. Check out new gear, earn rewards in the Season Pass and Veteran Rewards, and see new improvements to Escalation. Crossplay also comes to Spearfall in The Division 2, launching on November 26 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: GTA 6’s Best-Kept Secret Is the Key to Its Whole Design
recentItems.description:
In the final months of trailers, screenshots, and extended looks leading up to Grand Theft Auto 6’s launch, Rockstar was keeping a huge secret. It had revealed Jason and Lucia to the world years before and, by the summer of this year, we knew that their romantic relationship was core to the story. But until the moment the game went live, we had no idea that.... SPOILERS BELOW




 ...the pair were parents. As we all found out in the prologue, Jason and Lucia have a son, Tomás. And more than just a baby, this little infant is the key to GTA 6’s entire design ethos.

recentItems.title: CALX - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
recentItems.description:
Join developer True Colors for a deep dive into the gameplay and vibrant, strange world of CALX in this latest trailer for the upcoming atmospheric 3D action-adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. CALX will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on January 21, 2027.

In CALX, flow across the WARP-corrupted planet Syro. Master movement as the Seeker. Double jump, dash, levitate and grapple through atmospheric ruins. Scan, solve puzzles, and engage in measured combat in waves of stillness and frenzy. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

recentItems.title: Is It Worth Buying a Lo-Fi Camera When You Have a Phone? Yes, and Here's Why
recentItems.description:
There's something special about using a gadget that's so disconnected from your other devices and all the noise that comes with them, and in an era where smart phone tech is more capable than ever to computationally make every photo you take the "perfect" shot, it kind of ruins the fun of photography and overcomplicates things when you just want to capture a moment in time. In this video Nick dives into why the Camp Snap 2 and Kodak Charmera have reignited his love for photography thanks in part to their simplicity, lo-fi but great looking photos, and overall rejection of needing a smart phone to take interesting photos. Where these cameras lack in features, they make up for it by helping us be more present when capturing life's little moments. And that's the whole point of photography anyway, isn't it?
Written by Nick Maillet
